vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Catalina taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Valter showed Owen the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Catalina has been turning the European Elder over — asking after it at fires, handling it on work days — and now knows it deep enough to teach. (Their trade grows: ask them what they know.)
Catalina is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
💡 European Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🛡️ Kwame, Brayden, Patricia and Sari met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Kwame, Brayden, Patricia, Sari are hurt.
Clara: "The european elder patch is fruiting again. Somebody should get out there."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
🛡️ Kwame, Brayden, Patricia and Valter met them at the door — 4 put down. Kwame, Brayden, Valter are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Brayden, Patricia, Catalina and Owen met them at the door — 4 put down. Brayden, Patricia, Catalina, Owen are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Scarred The Big Beast lashes at sand-ghosts near you. Missed. (pocket_sand)

Brayden: "Walked past a good stand of european elder. Worth remembering where."
🛡️ Brayden, Patricia, Clara, Rosa and Mara met them at the door — 5 put down. Brayden, Patricia, Clara, Rosa, Mara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rosa just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village and a trader know more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Scarred Performance Review is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Scarred Performance Review for 95 (Hardlight knife).

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kwame just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Clara just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Kwame, Brayden, Patricia, Valter and Clara met them at the door — 5 put down. Kwame, Brayden, Patricia, Valter, Clara are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

The Scarred The Big Beast wears Sari's face. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track you — they don't track anything.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)

📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tupaq just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
